items.a: Pulses from Russia (red lentils, green lentils, chickpeas and dried peas) and dried fruit from Uzbekistan (seedless raisins (Kishmish) and seeded raisins).
Wholesalers, packers and food producers in Iran.
Asperlos is based in Mashhad, Iran. The company was registered in 2025 as Asperlos Gostar Fardad Trading Co. (LLC), registration No. 96011.

items.q: Why are there no prices on the website?
items.a: Prices depend on the product, quantity and delivery terms. Request a quote through the inquiry form or a messenger and we will send current terms.

items.q: What documents come with each shipment?
items.a: Each shipment travels with a phytosanitary certificate and a certificate of origin.
Yes. We handle customs clearance in Iran.

Final specifications for each shipment are agreed in the contract. For example, our green lentils (crop 2026, Saratov region) have a calibre of 6 mm and above, moisture max. 14%, foreign matter max. 2% and broken kernels max. 5%, and are supplied in 25 kg PP bags.

items.q: How do I request a quote?
items.a: Send us the product, quantity and delivery date through the inquiry form.
